List the charts the dashboard shows, by the page they are on. 'voidhash analytics chart <chart>'
runs one. --json also has what each measures, and the dimensions and metrics it takes.

Usage:
  voidhash analytics charts [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   Show help for this command
      --json   Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
  -q, --quiet  Print only ids, one per line
      --section <overview|revenue|subscribers|trials|churn|audience|paywalls|acquisition|web|app|locations|push|health>
               Only the charts of one page of the dashboard

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash analytics charts
  voidhash analytics charts --section paywalls
  voidhash analytics charts --json
